tasks.title: Add typed configuration, artifact paths, and shared pipeline state contracts
acceptance_criteria: Add a typed configuration module under `src/app/` using Pydantic settings for dataset inputs, artifact outputs, and runtime options.
Define shared pipeline state types used by the future orchestration layer so downstream nodes agree on inputs and outputs.
Document or expose a single package-level bootstrap location for future CLI or graph execution without implementing model logic yet.
Add focused unit tests for default settings, environment overrides, and pipeline state validation.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic dataset loading, schema validation, and split handling
acceptance_criteria: Add dataset models and loaders that validate expected fraud labels and feature columns before training starts.
Implement deterministic train, validation, and test split handling driven by configuration.
Reject malformed or incomplete input early with actionable errors instead of silently coercing data.
Cover loader behavior with fixture-based tests for valid input, missing columns, and split reproducibility.

tasks.title: Build leakage-safe feature preprocessing and artifact persistence
acceptance_criteria: Implement feature preprocessing that cleanly separates fit-time and transform-time behavior.
Persist fitted preprocessing artifacts so inference and explainability use the same feature representation as training.
Make feature ordering explicit and stable to prevent attribution or model drift from column reordering.
Add tests that prove preprocessing outputs are deterministic and that inference never refits training statistics.

tasks.title: Implement a baseline binary fraud classifier and training loop
acceptance_criteria: Add a baseline PyTorch classifier that consumes the persisted feature representation.
Implement a training loop with deterministic seeding, checkpoint output, and binary classification metrics.
Separate training configuration from dataset and artifact configuration to avoid hidden runtime coupling.
Add tests for tensor shape handling, checkpoint generation, and metric calculation on small fixtures.

tasks.title: Integrate Captum-based explanations aligned to the trained feature space
acceptance_criteria: Add explanation generation that runs against the trained model and the exact persisted preprocessing artifacts.
Emit explanation outputs that map back to stable feature names rather than raw tensor indexes.
Fail fast if model, preprocessing, or feature metadata are out of sync to avoid misleading attributions.
Add tests that verify attribution outputs are shaped correctly and remain aligned with feature names.

tasks.title: Orchestrate data loading, training, and explanation steps through LangGraph
acceptance_criteria: Add a LangGraph workflow that wires dataset loading, preprocessing, training, and explanation steps through explicit state transitions.
Keep graph nodes idempotent around artifact writes so reruns do not double-write or partially overwrite outputs.
Expose a single invocation path for the workflow from the application package boundary.
Add integration tests that exercise the end-to-end graph on a small fixture dataset.

tasks.title: Harden developer bootstrap, static checks, and end-to-end verification
acceptance_criteria: Ensure the repo bootstrap path installs all declared dev tools needed by the existing Make and CI command set.
Expand tests beyond smoke coverage so CI validates config, data loading, preprocessing, training, explanations, and orchestration.
Keep lint, typecheck, and test commands aligned between local development and CI.
Document any remaining environment assumptions that block reproducible setup.

tasks.title: Eliminate the remaining publication gap by embedding parquet provenance
acceptance_criteria: Make prepared-dataset and explanation publications single-file atomic artifacts by embedding their provenance manifests into parquet metadata instead of writing sidecar JSON files.
Keep orchestration reuse validation provenance-aware by reading embedded parquet metadata plus file fingerprints.
Retain the shared atomic temp-file-and-replace path for JSON/text and checkpoint outputs.
Add tests that prove dataset and explanation validation no longer depend on sidecar manifest files.
